'''Kejik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who lived on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They ran a [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulant]]-selling business with a stand in [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Till'in]]'s camp, which was located near the ruins of the ancient [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Kaleth]] and the [[Elarian Trail]]. A [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned Duros with large red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], Kejik lacked [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and did not speak the [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] [[Language/Legends|language]]. They wore a dark gray [[Robe/Legends|robe]] over his light gray [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]], along with a black [[Belt/Legends|belt]], [[Boot/Legends|boots]], and a dark-colored [[Armor/Legends|armored]] ornament on his right shoulder.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kejik appeared in the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. As a vendor located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Tython, Kejik and their shop are restricted to Republic-aligned players only. Kejik shares their name with a similar looking in-game [[Kejik (Balmorra)|Duros character]], who can be found on the planet [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], on the version of the planet available solely to Republic players.<ref name="TOR" />
